cash_breakdown.item: non-pledged time deposits with original maturity under 3 months
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: 1-2 month short-term deposits with creditworthy banks; small haircut for operating liquidity and group-level availability uncertainty.
cash_breakdown.reason: Short-term time deposits included in cash equivalents and not pledged.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Pledged for bank loans and bank overdraft facilities; cannot be freely stripped.

Manufacturing business with revenue HK$551m, 30-90 day customer terms, 30-150 day supplier terms, inventory HK$83m and volatile working-capital needs; reserve roughly 5% of revenue / under one month cash operating cost.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash needed to keep production, payroll and working capital running.

cash_breakdown.item: tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve for remittance, FX, tax and distribution friction because cash location and immediate extraction path are not fully disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Friction reserve before cash can be distributed or used by controller.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Leases are for buildings and plant/machinery used in operations; under going-concern owner-earnback view, they are reflected in profit/cash quality rather than deducted as detachable-cash financing debt.
cash_breakdown.reason: Continuing operating lease obligation, not paired with detachable funds.

profit_quality.assessment: 2024 reported profit converted strongly into cash, but the 2022-2024 profit record is volatile: 2023 was loss-making and 2024 is a recent rebound year. Main denominator therefore uses the 3-year parent-profit median HK$12.558m, then applies a 0.75 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Excluded reliance on 2024 peak/rebound profit as sole denominator.
Fair value gain HK$0.127m and interest income HK$0.442m are small and do not drive the denominator.
Manufacturing capex and working-capital reinvestment are material; 2024 FCF was strong but 2023 FCF after capex was negative.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 CFO HK$81.560m versus profit HK$61.859m and capex HK$21.922m; 2023 CFO HK$21.252m versus loss HK$25.676m and capex HK$32.112m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent turnaround, volatile apparel-label demand and recurring capex/working-capital needs justify haircut even though 2024 cash conversion was good.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Good in 2024, mixed over two disclosed cash-flow years because 2023 post-capex cash flow was negative.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Uses 2024 PPE purchase cash flow HK$21.922m as observed capex; exact maintenance/growth split not disclosed. December 2024 UV printer RMB9.8m indicates capacity/growth investment.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 inventory, receivables and prepayments increased materially as revenue recovered; payables partly funded this but cash needs cannot be ignored.

limitations: Market cap uses historical signal-date input from 2025-05-26, converted from CNY to HKD; it is not verified as the spot market cap on 2026-07-22.
Cash ownership by legal entity and immediate extraction route are not fully disclosed; cash was discounted and an operating/friction reserve was deducted.
